tool.name: alabama_business_search
tool.title: Alabama Business Entity Registry Search
tool.description:
Search official Alabama Secretary of State business-entity records by company name, returning entity ID, legal name, entity type, registry status, and location.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/al-business-entity-search'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; queries the public Alabama Secretary of State registry.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 10-30 seconds without detail pages, longer with include_details enabled; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use when verifying an Alabama-registered LLC or corporation, checking entity status, or building a lead list of Alabama businesses by name.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for Florida, California, or nationwide multi-state lookups, for contractor licensing, or for company officers/registered-agent name searches.
- Named alternatives: Use 'us_business_entity_search' for a combined Florida/Alabama/Iowa/Wisconsin lookup, 'florida_new_filings_search' for Florida entities, or 'california_contractor_license_search'/'us_contractor_license_search' for contractor licences.

search_query.description: Full or partial Alabama business name to search (e.g. 'SMITH' or 'Smith Services LLC').

max_results.description: Maximum number of entity records to return and bill. Defaults to 10.

include_details.description: When true, opens each result's detail page to add formation date, registered agent, and registered/principal addresses. Slower; leave off for a fast name-and-status lookup.

results.description: Collection of Alabama business-entity records matching the search query.

entity_name.description: Business name displayed by the Alabama public registry.

entity_type.description: Registry classification, such as LLC or corporation, when present.

status.description: Current registry status when present (e.g. Exists, Dissolved, Revoked).

formation_date.description: Date the entity was formed, from the detail record (requires include_details).

registered_agent.description: Name of the entity's registered agent (requires include_details).

principal_address.description: Principal place of business, where the state records one (requires include_details).

search_query.note: Wrap the single search_query string into a one-element array for the search_terms input.
